Real `launchctl print gui/UID` and `launchctl print-disabled gui/UID` outputs, read-only on macOS 26.5.2
(14 November 2026), then sanitized: every label, name, path and quoted string is replaced by com.example.*;
block layout, indentation, columns and sizes are kept ("gui/UID" stands for the real domain).
print-disabled-two-blocks-synthetic.txt is NOT measured: the second block follows the reviewer's memory of
macOS 13 and later and is replaced by a real sample once an older Mac is measured.
